text: {"101":{"about":["rustc_arena"],"refers":[],"why":"This describes the arena allocator model of allocating values and passing references to them."},"102":{"about":["rustc_middle"],"refers":[],"why":"Compiler type interning and pointer-identity comparison are central to rustc_middle's shared type representations."},"103":{"about":["rustc_middle"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_middle defines major compiler IRs, including HIR, THIR, and MIR, whose representations use interning and arenas."},"104":{"about":["rustc_query_impl","rustc_middle"],"refers":[],"why":"The compiler query system is implemented by rustc_query_impl, while rustc_middle defines its query declarations and modifiers."},"105":{"about":["rustc_query_impl"],"refers":[],"why":"This describes the query-driven execution architecture implemented by the compiler's query engine."}}
